Isabella is USER_010 (Isabella Rossi, isabella.rossi@acme.com), the only Isabella in users; 'submitted through email' fixes channel = email
'the service owned by me': the acting user USER_007 (Raj Patel) owns only SVC_003 (Acme Email Service)
'the item located in San Francisco with a cost greater than 2000' is CI_004 (Acme Email Server, LOC_003, cost 6000, in_use); CI_003 is also in San Francisco but costs 1500

USER_009 (Kenji Tanaka) is active, has the agent role and is a member of GROUP_003, so the assignment meets policy 3.2
'highest levels of impact, urgency, and priority': impact high and urgency high, and the policy 3.1 matrix gives priority critical

assumptions: boundary of the CI selector: CI_003 (Kenji Workstation, WS-SF-001) is also in San Francisco but costs 1500, so no new incident may be logged against it; four incidents (INC_011, INC_013, INC_019, INC_022) reference it on the seed

notes:
Both passes agree on every requirement, cell, value and disposition: the incident INC_024 (caller USER_010, service SVC_003, CI_004, assignee USER_009 in GROUP_003, email, high/high/critical, new), the two notifications selected by incident and recipient, the stay on CI_003 and all three checks kept; there is no disagreement to record.
The request's 'oldest resolved incident handled by the IT Support Team, together with the child incident associated with it' does not fit the seed exactly: INC_011, the oldest GROUP_003 incident in status resolved, has no child mapping and is itself the child of the closed INC_013. Both readings give the same resolver (USER_009) and group (GROUP_003), so no cell depends on the choice.
The incident requirement adds the anchor INC_024 and status = new (policy 3.1 default) to the benchmark's check; the notification requirements drop the benchmark's redundant JOIN on incident and keep every predicate.
Policy 7 (knowledge search and suggested links on incident creation) is not a requirement: no listed tool searches or links knowledge, and none of the seed's five articles (passwords, email client set-up, desktop boot, email account recovery and access) is about a network connectivity failure, so the set to link is undecidable. No parent or child link for the new incident is asked for, and no listed tool creates one.
